record.body:
## Description

Three tests in tests/test_tmux_integration.py fail on main and on the phase branch: prefix_s_opens_a_side_pane..., prefix_a_popup_renders_the_pane_repo_dashboard_with_waiting_running_time_and_failed_activity, prefix_a_popup_keys_only_walks_tabs.... The Activity section stays empty, so '✗ fx-broken check failed' never renders.

## Approach

Reproduce, find the root cause (fixture or dashboard code after the score/conductor split), fix it with the smallest change, keep tests meaningful.

payload.title: Fix the three failing tmux dashboard tests
